name: Skinner v3.3.5 — Silent In-Place Updates, UI Refinements & Gnash Cleanup
changelog: Seamless Silent In-Place Updates: Update process executes silently without Setup wizard dialogs or prompts, and relaunches the application immediately upon completion.
Streamlined Update Modal: Removed redundant close button and view changelog button, simplified header, and eliminated progress bar 0 artifacts.
Gnash Catalog Pruning: Removed all three ZombieWalker variant skins (ZombieWalker1, ZombieWalker2, ZombieWalker3) leaving 12 authentic distinct costumes.
Cryptographic Verification: All release binaries signed with official Ed25519 digital key and protected by SHA-256 manifests.
